classification.scope: Constructed mathematical examples; not empirical forecasting improvements or a numerical proof of the universal theorem.
classification.comparison_rule: absolute error <= tolerance * max(1, abs(analytic width))

general.scope: Six constructed polytopes, coordinate queries, hard budget two. No forecasting data, no exhaustive adaptive-policy enumeration, no hardware comparison. Times are one execution each; first run includes solver initialization.

dual.scope: Numerical optimality and hardest-record checks on existing synthetic instances plus declared edge cases. Not new empirical forecast results, formal interval arithmetic, or runtime scaling claims.

solver_comparison.measurement_scope: Existing single-run measurements, no new timing run. Method implementations perform different post-solve work: compact compiles an executable sampling policy. Absolute peak process working set includes Python and dependencies; not incremental solver memory.

public_grid.interpretation: Post-review descriptive cross-tab over the entire existing retrospective scenario grid. Repeated masks/seeds, model pairs and total tolerances are not independent trials. No new forecasts, missingness scenarios, tuning or acquisition. Separate bounds are a matched-information certificate comparator, not the strongest point-imputation or acquisition baseline. Full scope includes three BLEM series whose endpoints require raw-source regeneration; public scope replays Portugal and household only.

selection_scope.limitation: The source and marker establish the archived pipeline ordering; hashes/timestamps are not independent preregistration or evidence that authors had never inspected these historical targets.

historical_ties.scope: All 1,074 positive-width cases, both secondary policies and every saved positive support. Secondary LPs independently solved using product-vertex constraints and HiGHS IPM; no import of audit_ties, no forecast fit, no original full-study rerun. Frozen zero-width cases and all case/meter/cohort aggregates reconciled. Ordinary floating-point tolerances, not outward-rounded formal certificates.

bound_acquisition_workflow.scope: Metadata/source binding and constructed dispatch checks; not new empirical benefit or data-origin authentication

independent_task_binding.scope: Independent saved-task/source binding and constructed integration verification; not provider authentication, physical calibration, fresh empirical replay or new certificate proof

pair_gate.interpretation: A post-review replay of a declared allow/hold gate over saved sharp endpoints. The count reduction is in unresolved certificates under identical information and zero queries; it is not measured money, latency, manual workload, predictive accuracy, or acquisition savings. Separate-loss bounds are the matched certificate baseline, not the strongest point-imputation baseline. All donor directions in the primary grid are correct on the observed reference; held directions have feasible opposite-sign completions supported by the sharp endpoint theorem. The ledger does not export those full completion vectors or regenerate bounds. Constructed risk separations are separate evidence.

model_selection.scope: Secondary analysis of the same frozen retrospective archive; not an independent replication, production replacement, forecast-accuracy gain, measured labor saving, or recovery-cost reduction.
model_selection.candidate_selection: A unique historical-donor-completed MSE winner must have favorable saved donor point comparisons against all three peers. Truth is not used until validation. Nonunique preferences remain in the scenario denominator.
model_selection.total_tolerance_sensitivity: The source exports donor point rows only at zero total tolerance. The 1% and 5% analyses hold that original proposed model fixed and test its certificate under widened total constraints; they do not recompute or claim a donor imputation at those tolerances.
model_selection.certificate_rule: Authenticate that candidate against all three alternatives using the same-method sharp interval decisions with the existing 1e-9 scaled sign margin.
model_selection.margin_scale: Minimum certified MSE advantage over the three competitors divided by the squared training-period mean kWh, already saved as normalization_scale; this is not a percentage relative to unknown test MSE.
model_selection.uncertainty: 2000 whole-consumer resamples of paired scenario-coverage differences, seed20261012, when at least10 consumers exist. Descriptive convenience-panel stability only; shared calendar shocks and population uncertainty are not captured.

additional_consumers.interpretation: Fresh extended comparison-grid execution using frozen forecasts from30existing additional Portugal consumers. Same source/calendar; earlier primary recovery outcomes were already inspected. No untouched-source or blind validation claim, model refit, additional queries, deployment savings, or predicted accuracy improvement. High-demand masks use serialized targets under this newly fixed grid protocol; repeated seed-labelled deterministic masks are dependent.

independent_period_lp.scope: Independent whole-period linear-program representation checks paired endpoints only; no production imports. The separate-loss quadratic extrema and model training are not independently rerun by this checker.

independent_paired_separate.scope: Independent sampled recomputation of paired and separate-loss endpoints for all30consumers on two fixed scenarios. No production bound or closure function imported; common frozen predictions and declared masks/totals retained. All19440ledger decisions and counts checked. This does not independently recompute every scenario, train forecasts, or establish an untouched population or production cost benefit.

executable_audit.scope: Two availability-selected executable historical daily examples, not a new empirical performance estimate. No forecasting model refit, hidden-target input to the evaluator, paid retrieval, or production cost measurement.

counter_constructed.scope: Independent constructed prefix-query formula and game checks; no empirical study rerun
counter_constructed.grid_scope: Grid supports debugging only; analytic proof establishes continuum lower bound

counter_saved_reports.scope: Bundled report/ledger/table consistency, rational witness masses and covering-interval algebra. Does not reopen raw registers or recompute original-coefficient envelopes. Use reproduce_counter.py and check_half_cover.py for those fresh checks.

counter_feedback_triage.scope: Bundled triage ledger, exact rational finite-game primal/dual certificates, policy recommendations and adaptive envelope/half-cover algebra; does not reconstruct source coefficients or replay raw readings.

reviewer_counter_diagnostics.scope: Bundled-ledger arithmetic and exact rational printed witness; raw counterpart is analyze.py.

bounded_uncertainty_prototype.scope: Constructed LP prototype checks; no real-meter evidence or human validation

bounded_uncertainty_edges.scope: Internal AI reviewer edge checks; no heldout data; not human validation

cap_sensitivity_bundled.scope: Bundled-coefficient rational reproduction; no raw-meter reconstruction or model refit
cap_sensitivity_bundled.continuum_lower_guarantees: Exact all-answer single/pair covers, independently checked
cap_sensitivity_bundled.arithmetic: Exact fractions of bundled frozen binary64 forecast coefficients
cap_sensitivity_bundled.physical_width_scope: Absolute meter totals are not reconstructed; positive E cancels in relative-cap analysis

stored_error_exact_certificates.matrix_reconstruction: Independent sparse semantic construction; all exported coefficients/boxes/multipliers checked
stored_error_exact_certificates.arithmetic: Python Fraction only for certificates; no LP solver imported or run
stored_error_exact_certificates.scope: Rigorous support-defined adaptive-policy guarantee at the unchanged threshold; no exact optimum or floating online-branch implementation claim

stored_error_independent_exact_certifica.claim: Rigorous support-defined adaptive precision guarantee; no exact optimum or physical calibration claim.

stored_error_failure_lower_certificates.verification: Exact Fraction feasibility and transcript checks; no LP or numerical tolerance
stored_error_failure_lower_certificates.scope: Deterministic adaptive policies with at most two distinct permitted counter queries; fixed hidden-error model only

stored_error_independent_failure_lower_c.scope: Exact impossibility for deterministic policies with at most two declared queries; no randomized-adaptive or physical-error claim.

stored_error_fallback_fixed_certificates.verification: Independent exact row reconstruction and weak-duality residual-box check; no LP solver
stored_error_fallback_fixed_certificates.scope: Certified fixed-batch upper bounds plus correspondence to previously verified two-query support policies; no exact-optimum or physical-device claim

stored_error_fallback_branch_certificate.verification: Exact weak-duality row reconstruction and complete affine-envelope proof on [-.01,1.01]; no LP calls
stored_error_fallback_branch_certificate.runtime_scope: Actual rational-line callback implementation checked at all envelope breakpoints and intervening midpoint cells; no noisy recorded-data replay
stored_error_fallback_branch_certificate.original_primary_result: 22/29 at two queries remains unchanged; other seven use separately certified fixed three-query batches

stored_error_fallback_execution.scope: Implementation tests on fixed constructed feasible profiles; not new empirical performance results

external_stored_error_sensitivity.scope: Illustrative post-analysis bounded stored-readout sensitivity, not device-calibrated physical accuracy or response replay

external_source_qualification.scope: Independent offline cached-metadata qualification and internal chronology check; no network or refit

decision_ledger.electric_meter: OpenEnergyMonitor EmonPi v2, EmonTx4 or newer

external_source_qualification.chronology_interpretation: Source rule precedes all hourly data; detailed operational/training gates were locked after training-only inspection and before July retrieval. Internal timestamps are not external preregistration.

external_counter_cached_replay.containment: exact rational containment in all replayed terminal intervals
external_counter_cached_replay.sum: exact rational hourly increments sum to retained total
external_counter_cached_replay.no_bootstrap: three systems and dependent pair/block cases: report meter and paired counts, no IID intervals
external_counter_cached_replay.independence: new source and frozen pipeline; same-study implementation, not external human validation

external_counter_independent_check.scope: Independent internal arithmetic/LP checker; no fresh refit or physical-timestamp validation
external_counter_independent_check.LP_sample_rule: earliest positive-width case for each meter/model pair; all10batches
external_counter_independent_check.chronology_scope: lag endpoint API-grid labels are no later than declared issue; native sample times and historical delivery are unknown

http_cached_verification.scope: Source-token reconstruction matches every received payload hash; timestamp/budget/interval checks and independent adaptive second decisions. Timing summaries are descriptive for three fixed cases.
measurement_limitations: client_cpu_seconds covers measured request processing, not total optimizer CPU; planning wall time is separately measured.
Full hourly-range response includes two initially known endpoints; a five-interior-point response could reduce its payload further.
Client one-request-per-second waiting is separately logged and is not provider latency.
No provider server CPU, packets/TLS wire bytes, or population latency confidence interval is measured.

protocol_selection_independent.scope: Independent integration/source-correspondence check; exact mathematical certificates checked by existing separate programs. No new empirical, physical-calibration or optimization claim.

protocol_cost_frontier.model: cost = c_read * reserved_scalar_readings + c_round * information_rounds; c_read=1
protocol_cost_frontier.switching_condition: For each of the 22 adaptive-certified cases, adaptive costs 2+2r and fixed costs 3+r: adaptive iff r<1; at r=1 choose fixed for fewer rounds. Seven cases always use fixed-three.
protocol_cost_frontier.tie_rule: minimum modeled cost, then fewer information rounds, then fewer readings, then protocol name
protocol_cost_frontier.recorded_api_scope: Existing three-task, six-trials-per-policy microbenchmark; separate exact-stored-grid model. Timings are not prices or observations on the 29 error-sensitivity cases.
protocol_cost_frontier.scope: Minimum over supplied per-case certified catalogue under a hypothetical restricted interface. No shared requests, stopping optimization, monetary estimates, field benefit or superiority over the best fixed baseline is claimed.
protocol_cost_frontier.baseline_interpretation: Fixed-three is already optimal for r>=1 and adaptive-with-fixed-fallback already optimal for r<=1. The selector prevents choosing the wrong resource priority; it does not improve upon either baseline in its favorable region.

protocol_cost_frontier_independent.scope: Exact supplied-catalogue cost accounting and source correspondence, not measured monetary savings or new scientific certificate verification

printed_worked_example.scope: Bundled-witness exact check of saved binary64 coefficients, reported exact total, printed rational enclosures, all ten adverse columns and both continuum branches. Default replay does not require raw-derived geometry. Optional geometry cross-check is separately flagged; no raw retrieval, refitting or new sample is performed.

scope: Fresh isolated executable replay from bundled inputs with network disabled; includes cached new-source counter replay and archived HTTP-trace checks, but no model fitting, private BLEM raw regeneration, new HTTP measurements, repeated scaling measurements, or external independent replication.
